scope: Selected frozen local recordings and generated fixtures
method: Sequential actions; deterministic mixed-order repetitions, counts recorded per comparison; identical per-recording canonical results and independent full-catalogue rectangle oracle. Compute from execution logs, not observer wall time or peak RSS. Descendant function counters exclude driver polling/start mutation and future lease-check calls. Repeats reuse already-published checks. All dollar figures model US Starter marginal usage before allowances, exclude file I/O, storage and other system costs.
